create_dataset_loader: create a TactilePushingDataset to load tactile pushing data from JSON files with configurable batch size and episode length
load_tactile_sdf: load tactile signed distance field data from a JSON file and return tensor, cell size, and origin
get_batch_data: get a batch of tactile pushing data including image features, effector poses, and object poses for training
split_tensor_episodes: split a tensor into episode-length segments for processing variable-length tactile pushing episodes
visualize_pushing_2d: visualize 2D tactile pushing trajectories comparing optimizer results against ground truth poses
